messages:
maria: Quick ping — can someone review PR #4321? It's a small Terraform change to add a route in the gpu-subnet route table pointing 0.0.0.0/0 -> natgw-prod. Plan attached. Want to merge before EOD but happy to wait for maintenance window if needed. :pray:

jon: link?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321

maria: diff snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_route" "gpu_natgw" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.gpu.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.prod.id
  depends_on = [aws_nat_gateway.prod]
}
```

infra-bot: terraform plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy

ashley: quick read — looks fine from infra POV, but we need security sign-off for 0.0.0.0/0 to natgw. Also, prefer to apply during 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window. Can you put this behind canary in eu-west-1 first? :eyes:

maria: yes canary in eu-west-1 planned. I added var.canary_region = "eu-west-1" in the PR.

samir: CI failing on fmt check:
```bash
terraform fmt -check
1 file needs formatting
```
I'll push a fix in a minute.

maria: thanks — pushed fmt fix

deploy-bot: PR checks: plan ✅, fmt ✅, terratest failed — logs: module/vpc/test.go: TestRouteAttachment: timeout

samir: terratest flake, rerunning

security: @maria can you add a short justification & expected traffic profile? We need to sign off on opening default route to NATGW for gpu-subnet. Also include which CIDRs will originate traffic.

maria: justification: GPU pool needs egress to download model shards from S3 and container registries; traffic initiated from private GPU nodes to external, only egress via NATGW. Expected peak 50MB/s aggregated across the pool, mostly to S3 and quay.io

security: ok we need to document that in the change log and add an IAM policy audit to ensure no wide permissions. Please add a short note in the PR template.

jon: I'll take the code review after terratest passes. Can you add the changelog entry and the IAM audit note, @maria?

maria: done — added CHANGELOG.md entry and PR comment about IAM audit.

samir: terratest passed on retry ✅

jon: LGTM from me. @ashley can you do final infra approval for apply window? also who will run apply?

ashley: I can apply during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window tomorrow. Please ensure runbook steps in PR.

maria: runbook added with rollback steps and canary verification commands.

jon: approved

security: approved with docs attached. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all — scheduling apply for 02:30 UTC tomorrow. Will ping here before apply. :rocket:

maria: bump — ping before apply

ashley: noted. I'll be online and will coordinate.

infra-bot: Reminder: apply window requires at least 2 approvers and on-call infra present. Approvers: jon, ashley. On-call: samir.

maria: all set — thanks everyone.
